Name: Stabbing Sword Special
Author: PeaslyWellbott
Description:
When using the special move with a Sword equipped, you will now perform a flurry of stabs as if it were a Dagger. The move retains the longer reach of the Sword.

[spoiler]
[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/WA8jhvvwVRJXcbefLb/giphy.gif[/img]
[/spoiler]
Available config options:
[code]﻿"FlurryDamageMult" (default 0.8) - multiplier of weapon damage during the special move
"BaseCooldownOfSpecial" (default 3.0) - cooldown of Sword special move, in seconds
"FaceCursorForSpecial" (default true) - whether you turn toward the mouse before executing the special move
[/code]
Compatibility:
[list]
[*]Should work with any weapon classified as a stabbing/offensive sword or slashing/defensive sword (which are identical in-game).
[/list]
